lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's seventy-one? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 71? Nope!

lines.text: Positive whole numbers, each one the sum of the two before.
lines.caption: Positive whole numbers, each one the sum of the two before.

lines.text: Term ten is two thousand twenty-four. How big can the first plus second term be?
lines.caption: Term 10 is 2024. How big can the first plus second term be?

lines.text: Call the first two x and y, and their total T. Term ten is twenty-one T, plus thirteen y.
lines.caption: Call the first two x and y, and their total T. Term 10 is 21T, plus 13y.

lines.text: Count T down from ninety-five. The leftover has to be thirteen times y.
lines.caption: Count T down from 95. The leftover has to be 13 times y.

lines.text: Ninety-five leaves twenty-nine. Keep going, and eighty-four leaves two hundred sixty!
lines.caption: 95 leaves 29. Keep going, and 84 leaves 260!

lines.text: Thirteen times twenty! So the biggest sum is eighty-four!
lines.caption: 13 times 20! So the biggest sum is 84!

lines.text: Seventy-one was the trap. It works, but it's smaller.
lines.caption: 71 was the trap. It works, but it's smaller.

lines.text: Did you get eighty-four? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 84? Tell me below!
